run_convert_split: run the convert function to generate an ImageNet label text file from a dataset split directory
build_imagenet_label_file: build a text file mapping ImageNet image paths to their class labels from a directory structure
create_train_val_txt: create train and validation label text files from an ImageNet dataset directory structure
refactor_convert_function: refactor the convert function to accept a configurable root directory path instead of a hardcoded value
summarize_convert_function: summarize the convert function that scans class subdirectories and writes image paths with labels to a text file
